I will manage this plot using what we have at home because money is tight and the beans plot is small. Since beans fix their own nitrogen, I will spread manure from our cattle on the plot but I will not buy chemical fertilizer this season. I will plant bean seed we kept from last year’s harvest, weed by hand with my family, and rely on the rains since we have no way to irrigate.
